candidate.response_model: causal body-frame ridge model trained on 54058 real temporal samples
candidate.compensation: 0.25 s gain, 0.5 m/s hard limit, 0.3 s smoothing, horizontal lateral channel only

frozen_before_test.promotion_rule: any hit regression rejects v1; otherwise expand to five fresh paired seeds

model_diagnostic.interpretation: The causal response model still predicted next acceleration better than the simple causal baseline on the candidate run. The failed component was the controller objective: chasing instantaneous PN lateral-acceleration error altered the trajectory and worsened LOS stability and physical closure.

decision.cleanup: Controller compensation path and raw A/B logs removed; response-identification model, evaluator, tests and compact summaries retained.
decision.next_step: Do not directly feed one-step acceleration error back into velocity. If response-aware control resumes, optimize a multi-step predicted closest-approach objective with the analytic benchmark as an exact fallback.
